answer: Proof of Stake acts as a barrier where identity is tethered to capital rather than a fable of egalitarian access. By requiring an inlet of collateral to participate in block validation, the system forces an attacker to purchase majority influence, a strategy whose efficiency hits a nadir when the asset price scales with the network value. This economic cost makes cloning agents prohibitively expensive, as increasing the Sybil count merely dilutes the potential yield per unit of staked capital.
